record.title_zh: 马来西亚办公室装修检查清单
record.title_en: Office Renovation Checklist for Malaysian Businesses
record.excerpt_zh: 用一份受控清单协调办公室装修范围、业主审批、水电、网络、家具、测试、搬迁和交付。
record.excerpt_en: Coordinate office fit-out scope, landlord approvals, M&E, IT, furniture, testing, move-in and handover through one controlled checklist.
record.content_zh:
直接答案：办公室装修本质上是协调项目。布局、建筑规则、电力负载、空调、灯光、网络、家具和搬迁日期要一起核对，避免一个分包阻碍另一个。

使用方法：把下列各项替换为本项目的实际尺寸、明确责任人、获批图纸和书面记录，再用于报价、审批或施工决定。

确认人数和工作方式

记录人数、部门、会议类型、私密性、收纳、无障碍、访客、混合办公和未来变化，并用这些需求验证布局。

尽早建立审批责任表

列出业主、管理处、主管部门、顾问和专项提交，以及押金、保险、工作时间、出入和检查节点。

封天花前协调系统

叠合灯光、电源、网络、空调、消防接口、检修口和天花，在制作前通过图纸和现场解决冲突。

锁定家具和科技接口

确认工位尺寸、地插、显示设备、会议系统、打印机、茶水间电器、机柜位置和布线路径。

如果办公室范围包含定制柜、文件收纳或茶水间柜体，应将尺寸、板材与饰面方向、五金、进场和安装接口与一般装修分开列明。可同时查看全屋定制与定制家具服务及办公室装修服务，再通过免费报价表提交平面图和现场照片。最终范围与价格仍须根据现场查看和书面报价确认。

规划测试、搬迁和交付

明确调试、标签、竣工资料、培训、缺陷、清洁、搬迁顺序和业主收尾责任。

开工或签约前检查清单

  • 人数与房间需求书
  • 审批责任表
  • 协调后的水电网络图
  • 家具设备清单
  • 测试与标签计划
  • 搬迁和交付顺序

常见问题

网络规划什么时候开始？

应在布局、天花和家具定稿前开始，因为设备位置会影响电源、数据和检修。

业主装修指南可以后面再看吗？

应在设计批准前核对，因为它可能影响范围和提交。

交付应包含什么？

按项目约定测试记录、标签、竣工图、说明书、钥匙、缺陷和书面接受。

资料来源与适用边界

  • 吉隆坡市政局建筑管制部门
  • 马来西亚能源委员会非住宅电气装置安全守则

资料核对日期：2026 年 8 月 22 日。相关部门、管理处、顾问和产品制造商的要求可能变化；正式决定前请以项目所在地、具体范围和所选产品的最新书面资料为准。
record.content_en:
Direct answer：An office fit-out is a coordination project. Layout, building rules, electrical load, cooling, lighting, data, furniture and the move date must be reviewed together so one package does not block another.

How to use this guide: replace every point below with the property's actual dimensions, named responsibilities, approved drawings and written evidence before using it for quotation, approval or construction decisions.

Confirm occupancy and work patterns

Record headcount, departments, meeting types, privacy, storage, accessibility, visitors, hybrid work and future change. Use these needs to test the layout.

Start the approval matrix early

List landlord, management, authority, consultant and specialist submissions, plus deposits, insurance, work hours, access and inspection points.

Coordinate services before ceilings close

Overlay lighting, power, data, cooling, fire interfaces, access panels and ceiling systems. Resolve clashes on drawings and site before fabrication.

Freeze furniture and technology interfaces

Confirm workstation sizes, floor boxes, displays, meeting equipment, printers, pantry appliances, server or network locations and cable routes.

If fitted cabinets, filing storage or pantry units are part of the office brief, record dimensions, board and finish direction, hardware, access and installation interfaces separately from the general fit-out. Review the custom built-in furniture service alongside the office renovation service, then send the room plan and site photos through the free quotation form. Final scope and price remain subject to site review and a written quotation.

Plan testing, move and handover

Set responsibility for commissioning, labels, as-built records, training, defects, cleaning, move sequencing and landlord close-out.

Checklist before approval or start

  • Occupancy and room brief
  • Approval responsibility matrix
  • Coordinated M&E/IT drawings
  • Furniture and equipment schedule
  • Testing and labelling plan
  • Move-in and handover sequence

Frequently asked questions

When should IT planning start?

Before layouts, ceilings and furniture are frozen, because device locations affect power, data and access.

Can the landlord guide be checked later?

It should be checked before design approval because it can affect scope and submissions.

What should handover include?

Agree test records, labels, as-builts, manuals, keys, defects and written acceptance for the project.

Sources and scope boundary

  • DBKL Department of Building Control
  • Energy Commission non-domestic electrical installation safety code

Sources checked on 22 August 2026. Authority, management, consultant and manufacturer requirements can change; confirm the latest written requirements for the actual property, scope and selected product before making a final decision.
